Compound is a decentralized lending protocol on Ethereum. Compound sets its interest rates algorithmically based on supply and demand. Compound requires overcollateralized loans. Compound issues cTokens that represent assets supplied to the protocol. Compound is governed by holders of its COMP token.

Fluid is a DeFi protocol developed by Instadapp. Fluid uses a shared liquidity layer that serves its lending and trading components.

Silo is a decentralized lending protocol. Silo uses isolated lending markets so that risk from one asset does not spread to other markets.

Euler is a decentralized lending protocol that launched on Ethereum. Euler suffered an exploit in 2023 and was later relaunched as Euler v2. Euler v2 uses modular vaults and isolated markets.
